column1: # Known differences between scopeio and the reference readers.
# Timed sequences: every frame is a time point. With several sequences Bio-Formats maps the frames
# of a sequence to z and the sequences to time; scopeio returns all frames as time points (same
# planes in the same order, checked: identical pixels).
# Bidirectional z series: Bio-Formats returns a series per cycle when the z positions of the cycles
# differ (checked with a variant whose second cycle runs downwards in the same order: one series);
# scopeio puts the frames of every second cycle back in depth order and returns one series.
